requirement: XSD 1.0 Part 2 3.2.8.2: canonical midnight is 00:00:00; 24:00:00 denotes that same time value
root_cause: TimeDV.parse calls validateDateTime, which advances day 15 to 16 for hour 24. It resets day to 15 only for an explicit non-Z offset. AbstractDateTimeDV.compareOrder includes day at position 2, so Z or absent-zone midnight may compare unequal. dateToString omits day, making identical displayed values compare unequal.
